content.user_title: Review Frontend Code Against Team Rules
content.value_statement: Frontend reviews can miss team-specific React, styling, and workflow rules. This skill applies a structured checklist to frontend changes and reports prioritized fixes.
actual_capabilities: Reviews .tsx, .ts, and .js files when the user requests frontend review.
Supports pending-change reviews and file-targeted reviews.
Applies code quality, performance, and business logic rule catalogs.
Prioritizes urgent issues before suggestions in the response.
Reports file path, line reference, evidence, and suggested fix for each issue.
Limits large reports to the first 10 issues per section.
limitations: Focused on frontend files and project rules, not broad backend review.
Depends on accessible files and the current working tree state.
Does not define automated test execution or build validation.
Checklist coverage must be updated when project conventions change.

use_cases.title: Pre-commit frontend review
use_cases.description: Check pending frontend changes before submission and identify urgent rule violations.

use_cases.title: Focused component review
use_cases.description: Review named React or TypeScript files for styling, memoization, and data access issues.

use_cases.title: Team checklist enforcement
use_cases.description: Apply shared review standards consistently across repeated frontend reviews.

prompt_templates.title: Review my frontend changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my pending frontend changes with the frontend-code-review skill.

prompt_templates.title: Review specific files
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these frontend files for checklist issues: [add file paths].

prompt_templates.title: Prioritize urgent issues
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the frontend changes and highlight urgent issues before suggestions.

prompt_templates.title: Audit workflow components
prompt_templates.prompt: Review workflow node components for React Flow hook usage, memoized props, and workflow store access.

output_examples.input: Review pending frontend changes before I open a pull request.
output: Urgent issue: A workflow node component reads from workflowStore where no provider may exist.
Suggested fix: Use React Flow node hooks for data access in that component.
Suggestion: Move repeated conditional class logic into the shared class name helper.

output_examples.input: Review a React component that passes object props to a child component.
output: Urgent issue: A complex prop object is recreated during each render.
Suggested fix: Memoize the object before passing it to the child component.

output_examples.input: Review a file with no checklist violations.
output_examples.output: The review reports that no issues were found.

best_practices: Provide the exact frontend files or pending changes that need review.
Keep the rule catalogs current with project decisions.
Ask for fixes after reviewing the suggested changes.
anti_patterns: Using the skill for backend files outside its checklist scope.
Treating checklist output as a replacement for tests.
Ignoring urgent findings before opening a pull request.

faq.question: What files does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews frontend TypeScript, JavaScript, and React files requested by the user.

faq.question: Can it review pending changes?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports reviews of staged or working-tree frontend changes.

faq.question: Can it review a single file?
faq.answer: Yes. Name the file paths and ask for a focused frontend review.

faq.question: Does it run tests?
faq.answer: No. The skill defines review behavior, not automated test execution.

faq.question: What rules does it apply?
faq.answer: It applies code quality, performance, and business logic rules from the bundled catalogs.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report marks compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
